request: Inspect only the existing bounded Gate restart/abort test process and post sanitized structural final results after it exits; no duplicate model call, no product work.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
name=ai-core-handoff-restart-01ef
s=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' "$name")
if test "$s" = exited; then
 rc=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.ExitCode}}' "$name")
 out=$(docker logs --tail 1 "$name" 2>/dev/null | docker exec -i ai-core-model-gate python3 -c 'import sys,json; t=sys.stdin.read(); d=json.loads(t); a={}; a["step"]=d.get("step"); a["cleanup"]=d.get("cleanup"); a["error_type"]=str(d.get("error","")).split(":")[0]; a["two"]=d.get("two",{}).get("resident"); a["three"]=d.get("three",{}).get("resident"); a["after_restart"]=d.get("after_restart",{}).get("resident"); a["recovered"]=d.get("recovered",{}).get("resident"); a["abort"]=d.get("after_abort",{}).get("resident"); a["final"]=d.get("final",{}).get("resident"); a["final_active"]=sum(d.get("final",{}).get("active",{}).values()); a["final_queue"]=d.get("final",{}).get("queued"); print(json.dumps(a))')
 msg="AI_CORE_UDS_RESTART_REAL_FINAL EXIT=$rc $out"
else
 msg="AI_CORE_UDS_RESTART_REAL_PENDING STATE=$s"
fi
gh api -X POST repos/seigo-gace/ai-core/issues/1/comments -f body="$msg" --jq '.html_url' >/dev/null
echo RESTART_TEST_READBACK=POSTED

chat_decision_checkpoint.source_evidence: AI Core Issue1 6223964281 physical actual Gate restart/abort acceptance one-run submitted Source01ef after resident0, later 6223987589 still running; DebugAI PR115 independently informed comment 6224005596, no duplicate test.
